theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_rc_closed_graph_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : Euclid (m + 1)) (S : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), ‖v‖ = 1 → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ x' ∈ S, |inner ℝ (x' - x) v| ≤ ‖x' - x‖ / 2) → ∃ Γ : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsClosed Γ ∧ CountablyRectifiable m Γ ∧ S ⊆ Γ
